phrases.en: Can you bring me the bill, please?
Can you show it to me, please?
phrases.purpose: turn a missed number into visible information

phrases.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
phrases.en: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?

phrases.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.
phrases.en: I want to add this amount as a tip.
Can you bring me the card terminal, please?
phrases.purpose: keep the card and bring the payment device

phrases.es: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?
phrases.en: Can you give me the receipt, please?
phrases.purpose: close the payment loop with evidence
